{"text": "The function `GenerateSchema._common_field_schema` takes three parameters: `name`, `field_info`, and `decorators`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `name` parameter is the name of the field.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `field_info` parameter is an instance of `FieldInfo` containing metadata about the field.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function uses `_typing_extra.eval_type` and `replace_types` to resolve field annotations, updating `field_info` accordingly.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function merges new attributes derived from the resolved annotation into the existing `field_info`, with manually set attributes taking precedence.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function converts validators from decorators into validator instances using `_mode_to_validator`.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function applies `_apply_discriminator_to_union` when the field has a discriminator.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function pushes down `each_item=True` validators for V1 compatibility and applies them separately using `apply_each_item_validators`.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function applies field serializers and updates the field info with titles using an alias generator if one is provided.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function returns a `_common_field` instance containing the generated schema, serialization exclusion, validation and serialization aliases, frozen status, and metadata.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function modifies the `field_info` object in place when resolving annotations and merging attributes.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_common_field_schema` function is a core component of Pydantic's schema generation process that generates a schema for a given field.", "type": "intent"}
